barWidget.description: Starlink dish status in the bar with a live dashboard popup

schema.label: Dish address (host[:port])
schema.description: gRPC target of the dish. Default is the dish's link-local address; pushed to starlinkd live on change, no restart. This setting is the source of truth: if you change the target with `starlinkd set host` on the CLI, mirror it here or it will be pushed back. No DNS fallback by design (a VPN or foreign network must not redirect dish traffic).

schema.label: Hide when not on Starlink
schema.description: Widget hides itself while the machine is on another network. It reappears automatically when the dish is reachable again.
